Title: [LSJ] Justicar title tied to Camarilla status or Clan ?

Messages.Author: Jyhad_addict
Messages.Body:
If a malkavian antitribu plays derange on a Tremere Justicar, then it
becomes sabbat and thus loses his justicar title.
But if a malkavian plays derange on the Tremere Justicar, then:

a. does he lose his title, because he can't be malkavian and tremere
justicar at the same time ?

b. does he retain his title as Tremere Justicar ?

c. does he become Malkavian justicar ?

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Jyhad_addict wrote:

> If a malkavian antitribu plays derange on a Tremere Justicar, then it
> becomes sabbat and thus loses his justicar title.
> But if a malkavian plays derange on the Tremere Justicar, then:
>
> a. does he lose his title, because he can't be malkavian and tremere
> justicar at the same time ?

He loses the title, but not for the reason given. Justicar titles are
clan-based (the only clan-based title, I believe), so if you change to
another clan, you lose the title.

Unless the Tremere Justicar gains a new title while Deranged, or someone
else becomes Tremere Justicar in the meantime, he will resume the title
of Tremere Justicar when/if the Derange is moved, though.

--Colin McGuigan

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
> He loses the title, but not for the reason given. Justicar titles are
> clan-based (the only clan-based title, I believe), so if you change to
> another clan, you lose the title.

They're ALSO sect-based. You have to be a Camarilla Tremere to be Tremere
Justicar.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


They are.
See section 10.1 of the rules:
"Only Camarilla vampires can be primogen, princes, justicars or Inner
Circle members. Additionally, clan justicar titles can only be held by a
vampire of the appropriate clan."
